Stopped Runners at the 2026 Backyard Ultra World Team Championships

wtc_stopped.Rd

A dataset containing 925 runner records from the 2026 Backyard Ultra World Team Championships. The data records runner performance, nation, competition class and stopping information.

Usage

wtc_stopped

Format

A data frame with 925 rows and 9 variables:

runner

Name of the runner.

nation

Nation represented by the runner.

class

Competition class of the runner.

yards

Number of yards completed.

code

Code indicating the stopping reason.

reason

Description of why the runner stopped.

stopped_utc

Stopping date and time in UTC.

local_time

Local time recorded at stopping.

qualified_yards

Recorded qualifying yard count.

Source

Original CSV stored in data-raw/wtc2026-stopped-after-yard-124.csv. The original public data source should also be attributed in the package README.
